title: xpute manifest
description: A program's manifest: the memory, stack, packet room, stream and GPU its core asks for. xpute-gen writes MANIFEST from it into both ends.

gen.description: Where a file's code goes, each from this file's directory: its TypeScript (a protocol's enums in a folder named as it is, beside it) and its Rust (a manifest's constants, which the core's build script also includes as it links).

mem.description: The memory the runtime gives the core, which never grows.

bytes.description: The sizes a runtime may give, any one of them, each a whole number of regions. The program picks one; the module is linked against the smallest.

region_bytes.description: What a reservation is counted in.

min_heap_bytes.description: The heap the smallest size must leave past the front, the linker's data and the program's fixed ranges, checked as the core compiles.

module_bytes.description: A module's stack, first in the memory.

thread_bytes.description: A native core's thread's stack, outside the memory.

bytes.description: The most bytes a frame's packet takes, either way: a multiple of 8.

stream.description: A stream past the front's frames, which the core writes records into and something beside it runs.

gpu.description: What the core asks of its GPU, read by the GPU plugin.

features.description: WebGPU's feature names. The surface's format is the platform's, and the limits the adapter's.

optional.description: What it takes where the adapter has it.
